title: Hand 1: position and preceding-edge spelling with copying and templates
statement: Apply the same component configuration as M-005 to hand 1: a fitted mixture of glyph-trigram spelling, spelling conditioned on line position and the preceding word's final glyph, position vocabulary, page-local exact or one-glyph copying, and a prefix-core-suffix template. Compare held-out predictive cost to the bag and spelling baselines and M-001; the analysis tests predictive usefulness, not whether a specific historical process generated the text. Position and preceding-word context are supplied by the layout, and preceding-word context crosses line breaks within a page. On the public practice split, this fixed mixture scores 10.6422 bits per word versus 10.8328 for the M-001 specification re-evaluated on the same 1,551 words, with identical bag and glyph-trigram references; the result is exploratory on these pages.
source: M-005, held-out hand 2 mixture; M-001, previously scored hand 1 model. Identical fixed components to M-005, chosen before this public hand 1 evaluation, using the trusted model language in vs/models.py.
